subject: Cross-slice cost/latency workbench request: MVP scope & infra blockers
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Cross-slice cost/latency workbench request: MVP scope & infra blockers

Folks —

Heads-up: Acme Analytics flagged a two-day billing spike that correlates with a tail-latency increase on one of their heavy routes. Their CS team asked for a quick investigative surface we can point them to in the Console so they don’t open weekly support tickets for this pattern.

Rather than patching with ad-hoc exports, I want to propose a lightweight "Cost-Latency Correlation Workbench" MVP we can add to Console (and later surface via API). High-level asks:

- Sliceable heatmap showing cost-per-minute by tenant + route + model-variant for a selected time window.
- Token-path decomposition: per-token cost contributions (embedding vs. generation vs. rerank) where available.
- Tail-latency overlay with percentile lines (50/95/99) and ability to click from a time bin into sample traces.
- Trace/span linking: link to existing trace playback (where available) or export an anonymized sample for replay.
- Quick-export (CSV) and a small sample payload export for support to reproduce locally.
- Filters: model variant, quantization profile, batch size bucket, route tag, and region.
- RBAC: read-only for customer-facing CS and limited developer roles.

Three immediate infra/product decisions we need to unblock scope:
1) Telemetry retention spike: to provide per-token decomposition we need to retain more token-level aggregates for 30 days for our pilot customers. Ops estimate: ~15% ingestion uplift. Do we sign off on that uplift for pilot tenants?
2) Sampling policy: we need a configurable sample rate for full request payload capture (for traces/replay). Do we expose a tenant-level toggle for Dedicated and hosted?
3) Console surface: what level of screenshots/UX do we want for MVP (inline heatmap + drill vs. separate workbench page)? This affects Console dev effort.

I attached a tiny sample-export.csv from Acme (redacted) so you can see the shape. I created Jira INF-7192 as the umbrella ticket.

Goal: align on MVP scope + owners by EOD Friday so we can schedule a short kickoff with Acme next week.

Thanks —
Logan
Director, Observability Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample-export.csv (csv, 38KB stub)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 18:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-slice cost/latency workbench request: MVP scope & infra blockers

Thanks — this is a helpful framing. A few clarifying Qs and a proposed MVP slice to keep scope tight:

Q1) Pilot accounts: are we only doing Acme or 2–3 tenants? The telemetry uplift request is easier to approve if we limit to 1 customer + internal sandbox.
Q2) Token decomposition: do we need per-token full attribution in SQL-friendly form, or will per-segment (input vs. generation vs. embedding) aggregates suffice for MVP?
Q3) Replay: will we only support request payload export (anonymized) or do we expect to wire an internal playback tool?

Proposed MVP (small):
- Heatmap (tenant x hour) cost + 95p latency overlay (Console card)
- Per-segment cost aggregates (no per-token rows) for 7 days retention
- Export button that creates a redacted CSV and a single sample payload for CS to reproduce

If we agree on this smaller scope we can avoid the 30-day token retention ask and reduce ingestion uplift. I can draft a one-pager with the UI mock and instrumentation contract if you want.

Small ask: can Marissa own Console feature prioritization and Naomi own telemetry/schema changes? I can take the instrumentation contract + one-pager.

—Jasmine
Sr PM, Console

> Folks —
> 
> Heads-up: Acme Analytics flagged a two-day billing spike...

From: Ben Carter <ben@acme-analytics.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Cc: devops@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 00:47:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Cross-slice cost/latency workbench request: MVP scope & infra blockers

Appreciate the quick reach-out — we can definitely be the pilot. A couple notes from our side:

- We can keep it to Acme as the pilot. We have a couple of obvious spike windows: 2028-11-23 02:00-06:00 UTC and 2028-11-24 14:30-16:00 UTC (attached sample rows).
- The sample-export.csv Logan attached is redacted; we can provide a slightly larger export (anonymized user ids) to help design the decomposition. I'll upload to the S3 bucket and share ACL: s3://acme-exports/spike-20281123.csv
- We do need assurances that any payload exports are scrubbed for PII. Our legal team requires a memo if you plan to retain payloads beyond 7 days.

From a priority perspective, the heatmap + quick-export will help our ops immediately; per-token attribution would be great, but not a blocker for us if the per-segment aggregate exists.

Happy to join the kickoff next week.

—Ben
Head of Data Platforms
Acme Analytics

Attachments: acme-spike-sample.csv (attached, 54KB stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-slice cost/latency workbench request: MVP scope & infra blockers — decisions + next steps

Thanks everyone — quick summary and owners so nothing drifts: 

Decisions (agreed):
- Pilot = Acme only + internal sandbox (reduces telemetry uplift).
- MVP scope = Jasmine's proposed slice: heatmap + 95p overlay, per-segment cost aggregates (7d retention), export button with a single sample payload.
- No per-token 30-day retention for MVP. We'll revisit in Q2 once we have usage patterns.

Owners / next steps:
- Marissa Cole: Console epic & priority (create Console-epic, link to INF-7192) — due: Mon 12/4.
- Naomi Feldman: Telemetry schema change and sampling policy (7d aggregates + sample export flow) — due: Fri 12/8.
- Jasmine Liu: UI one-pager + mockups (will include mock CSV export) — due: Tue 12/5.
- Logan: coordinate kickoff with Acme and legal for PII memo; I scheduled a 30-min kickoff: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/2028-11-30-10am-workbench-kickoff

Ben: thanks for sharing the S3 link — Naomi will coordinate the exact redaction contract. We'll make sure exports are scrubbed and retention is limited to what we agreed.

Attaching a brief MVP scope doc for the group (workbench-mvp-scope.pdf).

If there are no objections I'll create the Console epic and add INF-7192 links.

—Logan
Director, Observability Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: workbench-mvp-scope.pdf (pdf, 120KB stub)
